title: RC 移相电路：输出有效值不变，只改变相位
statement: V̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s。两条支路并联在电源上：左支路 R_1 在上、C_1 在下，中点为 a；右支路 C_2 在上、R_2 在下，中点为 b。R_1 = R_2 = R = 200 Ω，C_1 = C_2 = C = 10 µF。
求 V_a、输出电压 v_ab 的有效值和初相，并说明调节 R 时 v_ab 如何变化。

questions.ask: a 点对地电压的有效值 V_a = ?
保持 C、ω 不变，R 从 0 增大到 ∞，v_ab 的变化是？
choices: 有效值始终等于 V_s，相位从 0° 逐渐变到 −180°
有效值从 0 增大到 V_s，相位不变
有效值始终为 V_s/2，相位从 0° 变到 −90°
choiceExplain: R = 0 时 V̇_a = V̇_s、V̇_b = 0，v_ab = v_s，并不是 0；可写出 V̇_ab/V̇_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) 再看它的模和辐角。
比值 (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) 含 ωRC，R 变化时它的辐角跟着变。
这把单条 RC 支路的相位范围（V̇_a 从 0° 到 −90°）和从电源中点取输出的移相器（有效值 V_s/2）混在了一起；本电路要按 V̇_ab = V̇_a − V̇_b 计算。
questions.explain: V̇_ab/V̇_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)，模恒为 1，辐角 −2arctan(ωRC)：R = 0 时为 0°，ωRC = 1 时 −90°，R → ∞ 时趋于 −180°。这就是 RC 移相器。

hints: 两条支路都直接接在 V̇_s 上，各自是一个分压器。先算 X_C = 1/(ωC)。
V̇_a 取电容 C_1 上的分压，V̇_b 取电阻 R_2 上的分压；V̇_ab = V̇_a − V̇_b。
把 V̇_ab/V̇_s 化成 (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)，注意分子、分母互为共轭。
solution: **4. 相量图。** V̇_a ⊥ V̇_b（−63.43° 与 26.57° 相差 90°），且 V̇_a + V̇_b = V̇_s，所以 a、b 两点都在以 V̇_s 为直径的圆上，V̇_ab 是这个圆的直径，长度恒为 V_s = **10 V**。
**5. 调节 R。** 改变 R 只让相位 −2arctan(ωRC) 在 0° ~ −180° 之间变化，有效值不变。

en.title: RC phase shifter: constant rms output, adjustable phase
statement: V̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s. Two branches are connected across the source: in the left one R_1 is on top and C_1 below, with midpoint a; in the right one C_2 is on top and R_2 below, with midpoint b. R_1 = R_2 = R = 200 Ω, C_1 = C_2 = C = 10 µF.
Find V_a and the rms value and initial phase of the output v_ab, and explain how v_ab changes when R is adjusted.

questions.ask: rms voltage of node a to ground, V_a = ?

questions.explain: V̇_b = V̇_s·200/(200 − j100) = 10·j2/(1 + j2) = 8.944∠26.57° V. V̇_ab = V̇_s(1 − j2)/(1 + j2); numerator and denominator have equal magnitude, so V_ab = V_s = 10 V.

questions.ask: With C and ω fixed, R is increased from 0 to ∞. What happens to v_ab?
choices: Its rms value stays equal to V_s while its phase moves from 0° to −180°
Its rms value grows from 0 to V_s, the phase is unchanged
Neither the rms value nor the phase changes
Its rms value stays V_s/2 while the phase moves from 0° to −90°
choiceExplain: At R = 0, V̇_a = V̇_s and V̇_b = 0, so v_ab = v_s, not 0; write V̇_ab/V̇_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) and look at its magnitude and angle.
The ratio (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) contains ωRC, so its angle changes with R.
This mixes the phase range of one RC branch (V̇_a goes from 0° to −90°) with the shifter that takes its output from a centre-tapped source (rms V_s/2); here compute V̇_ab = V̇_a − V̇_b.
questions.explain: V̇_ab/V̇_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) always has magnitude 1 and angle −2arctan(ωRC): 0° at R = 0, −90° at ωRC = 1, approaching −180° as R → ∞. This is the RC phase shifter.

hints: Both branches sit directly across V̇_s, each is a voltage divider. Start with X_C = 1/(ωC).
V̇_a is the share across C_1, V̇_b the share across R_2; V̇_ab = V̇_a − V̇_b.
Write V̇_ab/V̇_s as (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) and notice that numerator and denominator are conjugates.
solution: **4. Phasor diagram.** V̇_a ⊥ V̇_b (−63.43° and 26.57° differ by 90°) and V̇_a + V̇_b = V̇_s, so both points lie on the circle with V̇_s as diameter, and V̇_ab is also a diameter of that circle: its length is always V_s = **10 V**.
**5. Adjusting R.** Changing R only moves the phase −2arctan(ωRC) between 0° and −180°; the rms value stays the same.
